title: Trailer #1: 6x12 Utility Trailer
shortDescription: Commercial 6x12 utility trailer with expanded steel sides, tandem axles with chrome rims, and fold-down ramp.
fullDescription: Heavy-duty 6x12 utility trailer built for tough hauling jobs in Corinth and Northeast Mississippi. Equipped with tandem axles, shiny chrome wheels, tubular steel top rail, expanded steel mesh sides, and a heavy-duty rear fold-down ramp gate for effortless loading of riding mowers, zero-turns, ATVs, and heavy cargo.
